corrections.why: 25.9 m (85 ft) is the height planned in the 1923 report; the 1955 survey describes the lookout as about 90 ft (27.4 m).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1923 report planned 85 ft; the 1955 survey describes about 90 ft. The story reports the survey figure and the planned figure.

The 1923 report says only 'Summit'. The survey station named Cliff sits on Summit Mountain, and its datasheet position (46.4502, -87.6301) matches the brief's coordinates, so the story links the two by name and place, and labels that link as an inference.

sources.title: Survey mark RK0547, Cliff RM 1 data sheet

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, both describing the tower before 1961. No source found on its fate, removal, or current state; the story says so and does not invent a site description. Two web searches and the Michigan fire tower site found nothing on this tower. Local papers (Ishpeming, Negaunee, Marquette) or Michigan DNR records are the next places to check for a removal date. The 1923 report's 'Summit' is linked to Summit Mountain by the matching location and the station name, not by the newspaper itself.
